title: Final Electric Field
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for the electric field E at point p must be correctly derived and presented.

title: Final Surface Charge Density
description: Essential Criteria: The bound surface charge density sigma_b must be correctly derived and presented.

title: Boundary Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The application of boundary conditions for electric fields at the surface of the sphere must be correctly shown.

title: Polar Coordinates Usage
description: Important Criteria: The use of polar coordinates in expressing the electric field must be correctly implemented.

title: Correct Constants
description: Optional Criteria: The constants epsilon, epsilon_0, and K_e should be correctly defined and used throughout the solution.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common sign mistakes in the components of the electric field or surface charge density must be avoided.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Units must be consistent throughout the calculations for electric field and charge density.
